scenes.text: Roman symbols include I equals 1, V equals 5, X equals 10, L equals 50 and C equals 100. Use IV, IX, XL and XC for subtraction forms.
Write 40 as a Roman numeral. The answer is XL. Roman numerals use I, V, X, L and C: 40 equals XL.
A clock label at a farm is XLII. What number is it? Pause to choose and explain.
A clock label at a farm is XLII. What number is it? The answer is 42. XLII represents 42.
